top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit hardens ARM64 Win64 exception/unwind emission against malformed or prematurely emitted .seh_handlerdata. The test updates exercise the new behavior by expecting reduced relocations and by adding a case where handler data is left orphaned without corresponding pdata/xdata entries.
